Tram line approved

The city council approved the new tram line on Tuesday after a long debate. Construction will begin next spring and is expected to run for three years. Local businesses along the route asked for clearer schedules and better signage during the works.

The transport department promised weekly updates on progress and a hotline for complaints. Residents welcomed the decision, noting that the eastern districts have waited a decade for a direct connection to the harbour.

Funding comes from the regional budget with a small municipal share, and the first trams are planned to run before the end of the decade.
